units.title: HEALTH, SAFETY AND SECURITY IN PLUMBING.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Personal health and hygiene

performance_criteria.description: State the importance of maintaining good personal hygiene.
Wear clean, smart and appropriate personal Protective Equipment.
Work safely at all times, complying with health and safety and other relevant regulations and guidelines.
Describe how to deal with cuts, grazes and wounds and why it is important to do so
Get any cut, grazes and wounds treated by the appropriate person
Report illness and infection promptly to the appropriate person.
Supervise the use of Personal Protection Equipment such as Head Protection, Foot Protection, Face and eye Protection, Hand and Body protection and regulatory protection.
Summarize own responsibility under the health and safety Act as it relates to own occupation.
Guide others general rules on hygiene that must be followed.

learning_outcomes.description: Maintain hygienic, safe and hazard free workplace

performance_criteria.description: State the importance of working in a healthy, safe and hygienic workplace.
Report any accidents or near accidents quickly and accurately to the proper person.
Promote health, hygiene and safety procedures during work.
Practice emergency procedures during work.
Ensure organizational security procedures are followed.
Ensure the disposal of waste and Pollution control with organic and inorganic waste disposal methods.
Promote sound and noise control and protection methods.
Supervise identification of any hazards or potential hazards and deal with these correctly.
State where information about health and safety in your workplace can be obtained.
Describe the types of hazards in the workplace that may occur and how to deal with them.
Differentiate between hazards that can be dealt with personally and those that should be reported to appropriate personnel.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Safe and Secure Workplace

performance_criteria.description: Carry out organizational procedures on how to warn other people about hazards and why this is important.
State why accidents and near- accidents should be reported and who they should be reported appropriately.
Describe the types of emergencies that may happen in the workplace and how to deal with them.
Indicate where to find the first-aid equipment and locate the authorized personnel.
Lift and handle materials in line with work environment procedure.
State other ways of working safely that are relevant to own position responsibility and its importance.
Describe organizational emergencies procedures, in particular fire, and how these should be followed.
State the possible causes for fire in the workplace.
Describe how to minimize the possibility of fire in the workplace.
State where to find the alarms and how to set them off.
State why a fire should never be approached unless it is safe to
State the importance of following the fire safety laws
Describe organizational security procedures and why these are important
Ensure security of equipment’s in work environment within your responsibility
Ensure security procedure for the movement of personnel and visitors are followed in your work environment
State the importance of reporting all usual or non- routine incidents to the appropriate personnel

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Complex Communication System in a Work Environment

performance_criteria.description: Describe simple non-verbal means of communication.
Interpret concept of symbols and signs
Appropriate Supervise the use of audio and electronic means to pass on necessary information.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Source of Information and Management in a Work Environment

performance_criteria.description: Participate in creating and making functional the source of information in an organization and work environment.
Make accessible the source of information in an organization or work
Environment relate appropriately with the source of information.
Use the various information flow system in an organization or work environment to overcome challenges.
Ensure proper documentation retrieval of information in accordance to procedure in a work environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Communication Processes in a Work Environment

performance_criteria.description: Ensure the accessibility of the communication equipment in the work environment.
Describe the effective use of the various communication channels in a work.
Environment demonstrate the use of various communication means in a work environment.
Ensure effective information flow to the right personnel
Ensure the effective deployment of the use of symbols, signs and codes.
Ensure that instructions are obeyed and disseminated in line with ethics of the work environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Communication Equipment Deployment

performance_criteria.description: Ensure that communication equipment are in good working condition.
Liaise with the maintenance unit to ensure that communication equipment are maintained regularly.
Liaise with appropriate authority to replace communication equipment in the event of loss or damage.
Ensure that communication equipment are well secured in a work environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Various Team Roles on the Construction Site

performance_criteria.description: Distinguish among various teams e.g. Masonry, Carpentry, Iron bending, Plumbing etc.
Identify the role of each team.
Discuss the importance of each team
Deliver quality output as a team player.

learning_outcomes.description: Supervise Team Activity

performance_criteria.description: Discuss the method of carrying out activities with team members.
Distribute work load and supervise activities.
Select materials and tools required for each team activity.
Interpret and ensure understanding of directives to team members.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Communication Flow

performance_criteria.description: Communicate work related information/ requirement clearly to team members.
Inform co-workers and superiors about any kind of deviation from work plan.
Address the problems effectively if need be to superiors appropriately.
Gather instructions from superiors and respond effectively.
Communicate to team members/subordinates of the right work techniques and methods.
Obtain clarification and advice from superiors as per work information were necessary.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Water Supply Pipe Layout.

performance_criteria.description: Make a sketch drawing or line diagram of pipe work.
Identify appropriate pipe, size, and fittings.
Select appropriate pipe, sizes, and fittings in line with sketch.
Select tools and equipment to be used.
Used selected tools and material to install pipe according to specification.
Quality checks the installed pipe.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Water Storage Tank Installation.

performance_criteria.description: Identify the tools and equipment to install a water storage tank.
Interpret the drawing and identify requirement in reference to 1.1 above
Install a water storage tank to the required specification.
Mention two different storage tank faults.
Explain the procedure of clearing and disinfection in storage tank fault.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Pumping Machine Installation.

performance_criteria.description: Identify tools and equipment to install pumping machine.
Select appropriate pumping machine in line with the specification reference to 1.1 above.
Quality checks the installed pumping machine.
Mention 3 different type of pumping machine used for water supply.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate sewage pipe laying in Plumbing work.

performance_criteria.description: Identify appropriate tools and equipment material to be used.
Select appropriate tools and equipment material to be used.
Identify the position of septic tank and soak away.
Excavate to get the appropriate slope level (ratio 1:100) at 1cm drop of 1m
Laying of pipes to the direction of specific and soak away.
Back full the laid pipe appropriately.

units.title: CHECKING AND TESTING EXTERNAL PLUMBING INSTALLATION

learning_outcomes.description: Check Installed Pipe Work and Component.

performance_criteria.description: Carry out checks on the installed external pipe network to ascertain any loose joint (not water tight) on the network.
Identify any inferior pipes and fittings used for the installation
Address the fault by taking different approach within an area of work specified
Explain the disadvantages of using the low quality pipes and components.
Check installation and correct positioning of component in line with designed specification.

learning_outcomes.description: Test Plumbing Installation.

performance_criteria.description: Carry out hydrostatic test of the installed pipe network to ascertain whether there are leakages.
Perform testing on the appliances installed to full working capacity and in accordance with the working standards and specifications.
Reporting test result to the immediate supervisor on the test carried out on the installation.

learning_outcomes.description: Correct Faults in Plumbing Systems to Speciﬁcation

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the ability to isolate or prevent unauthorized use of unsafe systems or components.
Locate faults through interpretation of information on system or component Performance, visual inspection, checks, or diagnose of test.
Initiate action to take when the system or components does not work to full performance specification.
Carry out Maintenance of fault in accordance with safety and work place procedure.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply Pipe Cutting Tools of Copper, Galvanize, Stainless steel and Plastic

performance_criteria.description: Identify the different cutting tools for pipe cutting.
Select the appropriate cutting tools used for cutting copper, galvanize and plastic pipes.
Explain the importance of using appropriate pipe cutting tool.
Use cutting tools appropriately to cut the following pipes, copper, galvanize and plastic.

learning_outcomes.description: Thread of Plastic, Galvanize and Stainless steel Pipes Understand Safety Requirement in Work Place

performance_criteria.description: Identify pipes that can be threaded
Select the right size of dies for threading the following pipes; a) G.I 25mm b) Plastic 20mm
Perform basic threading on the selection of 2.2 PC above.
Explain the importance of using the right size of dies for threading.
Assemble the threaded pipes to form a simple network.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand work flow and space arrangement

performance_criteria.description: Identify the equipment and tools required for work.
Identify material required in the work place.
Determine space requirement for labor operations.
Recognize the sequence of work
Arrange material equipment and labor in accordance to sequence of work.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Safety Requirement in Work Place

performance_criteria.description: Explain the importance of good housekeeping.
Identify safety gadget required in the work place.
Identify exit route in case of emergency.
Initiate safe access to work place.
Adopt emergency procedure in work place.
Return every safety gadget after work.
Maintain appropriate safety measures.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Security Needs in Work.

performance_criteria.description: Identify security personnel in work place
Maintain procedure to keep work environment secure
Report any security threat in work place.
